name: Security Scan on Code Change
description: Triggers a security scan via security-scanner MCP whenever source code files are edited

then.prompt: A source code file was edited. Run a security scan on the modified file using the security-scanner MCP server's scan_code tool. Report any HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerabilities found. Log the scan results to the audit-logger MCP server using the log_event tool with event_type 'security_scan_triggered'.
